title: Pile-up on BR-101 in Itajaí Causes Three-Kilometer Traffic Jam
seoTitle: Itajaí BR-101 Pile-up Causes 3km Traffic Jam
subtitle: Five Trucks and One Car Blocked the Right Lane of the Highway
excerpt: A pile-up involving five trucks and one car on BR-101, km 112.1, in Itajaí, caused a three-kilometer queue and the closure of the right lane, according to reports.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Wednesday morning, a pile-up involving five trucks and one car blocked the right lane of BR-101, at km 112.1, in Itajaí, on the northern coast of Santa Catarina. The accident generated a traffic jam of approximately three kilometers in the northbound direction, towards Curitiba.

What Happened on BR-101 in Itajaí

The vehicles collided in the region of the bridge over the Itajaí-Açu River, near the border between Itajaí and Navegantes. Images show the six vehicles involved, with no reported victims, only material damage.

How the Lane Was Closed

According to the concessionaire Arteris Litoral Sul, the right lane was closed, and traffic was diverted to the left lane. Teams from the Federal Highway Police (PRF) and emergency services were called to signal the section and begin vehicle removal.

Impact on Traffic

With the right lane out of commission, drivers were advised to remain in the left lane, resulting in delays and a kilometers-long queue. The congestion affects the flow of vehicles heading towards Curitiba.

PRF Guidelines

The Federal Highway Police recommends reducing speed when approaching the bridge, carefully transitioning lanes, and maintaining a safe distance from the vehicle ahead. These measures aim to prevent new incidents while the lane remains partially blocked.

Next Steps for Reopening

Emergency teams continue working to clear the road and reopen the right lane. Meanwhile, traffic proceeds in the left lane, with delays in the northbound direction. Drivers using this route are advised to follow updates from the PRF and the concessionaire to plan alternative routes.

With information from ND Mais.
